name: What is the process for building an ADU with Cali View Builders?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for building an ADU with Cali View Builders?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our ADU construction process begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision and assess your property. We then move to the design phase, creating plans that meet your needs and local zoning requirements. Once designs are approved by you, we handle all necessary permitting with the local authorities. After permits are secured, our skilled construction team begins building your ADU, maintaining open communication and managing all aspects of the project. We conclude with a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our ADU process involves consultation, design, permit acquisition, construction, and a final walkthrough. We manage each step to bring your vision to life.
